description: Věstníky - Český telekomunikační úřad is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Digitální a informační agentura. The dataset contains published bulletins depositors Czech Telecommunication Office and their content published on the portal gov.cz. Coverage: Digitální a informační agentura. The portal shows the English title as "Bulletins - Czech Telecommunication Office" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Digitální a informační agentura. Its keywords include oznámení, úřední sdělení, věstníky. The listing shows 2 download or service links in CSV, XLSX. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/17651921/9c5d32dc5824837f2175d43fba8d688b/distribuce/9e5b57e1d1a6098a236913bc23190de9/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
